cells: Verify a coordinated journey from home to transportation, parking, campus entrance, public interior routes, destination identification, staff assistance, and the return journey using consistent names, landmarks, maps, directories, graphics, lighting, and digital content.
Readiness window: July 8-25, 2025 | First-day monitoring: July 28, 2025 | Public office hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m.
Controlled source: International Health Facility Guidelines 2023 Part W: Wayfinding Guidelines, published by TAHPI. Treat wayfinding as the complete journey, not only interior signs.
Open actions remain owner- and date-specific. Yellow cells indicate an item requiring active follow-up before first-day operations.
